remarks: Perfectly positioned in the heart of Downtown Stamford, 20 North Street, Unit 11-2 offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy a lifestyle centered around convenience, accessibility, and vibrant city living. Located within the sought-after Essex House community, this residence places you just moments from Stamford's best restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and everyday essentials.  Enjoy the ease of being minutes to the Stamford Train Station, I-95, and downtown, making commuting to New York City and surrounding areas seamless. Nearby Mill River Park, Stamford Town Center, UCONN, restaurants, fitness studios, and nightlife create an energetic yet comfortable urban atmosphere right outside your door.  Whether you're seeking a peaceful residence with beautifully manicured grounds or a low-maintenance lifestyle close to everything Stamford has to offer, this centrally located home combines comfort, walkability, and commuter convenience in one of the city's most desirable downtown settings.
